featured_reviews.review_text:
This Fish Market is located near Station Goregaon East. Its quite old & big enough to get a variety of Fishes daily.. Mostly Fish available after 9 am, but at 10am all sellers & variety of fish available here..
People from Goregaon Eadt & near by areas frequently come to this market.. The rates depends on the season, but mostly reasonable if u bargain..

featured_reviews.review_text: A typical Mumbai fish market. You can get many types of fish here from the Mumbai's native fisherman. featured_reviews.name: Rakesh Vasani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a very good experience in the store. The owner (Rakshit Kotian) helped with not just selection of the aquarium but also guided me with detailed information on how I should set it up and what would be the best combinations for my Betta. Unlike any other store, Rakshit actually stopped me from over-buying, asking me to set things up slowly as I am a first timer.

The store has a lot of variety of fishes, different breeds of fishes, shrimps, etc. All well kept and managed.

The greatest thing there though, is the large almost 6 feet tank that he has set up with plantation and fish in it. Very beautifully made. Has different plants and weeds in it. With multiple variety of fishes. Amazing to look at.

Would highly recommended the store, the location is a little difficult to find, but besides that, everything you need is available.

featured_reviews.name: Smith Sirvel
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am extremely disappointed with my recent order from JP’s Lunch Home. I had ordered mutton gravy expecting a proper dish with meat, but what I received was just plain gravy with absolutely no mutton pieces in it.

This is not a minor mistake—the main component of the dish was completely missing. It feels misleading to charge customers for a mutton dish and deliver something that doesn’t even contain mutton.

What makes it worse is the inconvenience caused. I was left without a proper meal and had to go through the hassle of raising a complaint and following up for resolution. This is not the level of service one expects when ordering from a listed restaurant.

Restaurants need to take basic quality checks seriously before dispatching orders. Sending out incomplete items reflects very poorly on both the restaurant and the delivery platform.

I hope this feedback is taken seriously and necessary action is taken so that other customers do not face the same issue.

featured_reviews.name: Pratik P
featured_reviews.review_text:
**Absolutely disgraceful and humiliating experience**
This was not just bad service, this was outright insulting behavior by your staff.
A waiter named “Anna” displayed shocking levels of arrogance, rudeness and complete lack of basic etiquette. Our order was delayed by over 30 minutes and despite asking multiple times, we were blatantly ignored. When he finally chose to respond, it was with a careless and rude excuse about oil being refilled, as if customers are expected to tolerate such delays without communication.
What happened next was even worse.
When the food arrived my wife noticed that the halwa portion served was not even a spoonful, which is unacceptable. Another staff member showing basic common sense and courtesy, provided an extra serving as a goodwill gesture.
But then, in an act that was deeply disrespectful and outright shocking, this same waiter “Anna” walked up to our table and snatched the extra serving directly from our plate without even asking us, questioning why it was given.
This was extremely humiliating, especially in front of others. My wife felt insulted and we had to explicitly ask him to stay away from our table.
Let me be very clear, this is not a small mistake. This reflects complete failure in staff training, customer respect and management oversight.
We chose not to create a scene there, but this experience has ensured we will never return.
If this is the standard of service you tolerate, customers should think twice before visiting.
Train your staff or replace them because this level of behavior is unacceptable.
**Very very poor experience given by JP and your staff "Anna"**

featured_reviews.name: Sanntosh Shringarpure
featured_reviews.review_text:
Hits and misses at this Mangalorean spot:

​I visited The Fisherman’s Kitchen on a Friday evening with high expectations, given the name and the positive reviews. While the atmosphere is family-friendly and the location is convenient (right below Bangur Nagar Metro with valet parking), the food was a mixed bag.
​The Standouts: The Pomfret in Banana Leaf was easily the highlight—the fish was incredibly fresh and perfectly cooked (4.5/5). Pairing the remaining gravy with Neer Dosa was the best part of the meal.
​The Letdowns: Unfortunately, the Prawns Tandoori didn't taste fresh (2.5/5), and the Crab Soup was watery with very little meat. The Kadipatta Chicken was also quite average; the chicken felt a bit tough and lacked that punchy Mangalorean flavor I was looking for.
​The Verdict:
​Ambience & Service: 3.5/5
​Alcohol Variety: 4/5
Food: 3/5
​Value for Money: 3/5
It’s a decent place for a family outing, and perhaps I caught them on an off-night, but for a seafood specialty restaurant, I expected more consistency in freshness.

featured_reviews.name: Sunil Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text: The Fisherman’s Kitchen in Goregaon offers a fantastic seafood and Mangalorean cuisine dining experience. The dishes are fresh, well-seasoned, and packed with authentic coastal flavours. The Sri Lankan Prawns are a must-try—rich in flavour and perfectly cooked. The Malabar roti was absolutely outstanding, soft, fluffy, and almost as light as a puri. The Mangalorean Chicken Sukka was equally delicious, though the quantity felt slightly less. While the ambience has room for improvement, the warm and attentive service makes up for it. Overall, it’s a great spot for anyone craving quality seafood and authentic Mangalorean food in Mumbai.

featured_reviews.name: Sonam Karani
featured_reviews.review_text:
A place which is must visit for all sea food lovers. So we went to this place for some delicious fish food and they get the best on plate. We ordered couple of dishes which is also must eat when you are visiting them . So we started with Crab Lollipop, Bombil Fry, surmai fry followed by mackerel fry , neer dosa , Bhakri and Rice . So when you order neer dosa the rasa comes along with it and their green coconut chutney served with fry fish is too good . Everything over here is absolutely fresh and delicious and light on stomach. Only a little work on hygiene and interior can be worked on and make it more better. Rest everything over here is amazing.
Kudos to the chef for maintaining the taste and quality of the food consistent over the years which grabs all attention for the delicious sea food lovers 😋

featured_reviews.name: Jaanya M
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Konkan Swad after years and it’s nice to see that the place has remained pretty consistent over time.

Tried the prawn curry with rice…the curry was decent, flavourful and had that typical coastal touch. It’s a simple, comforting meal if you’re craving Konkan-style seafood.

One thing I didn’t really like though is that you have to order everything separately, which makes the meal feel a bit incomplete unless you keep adding items.

Overall, still a reliable spot if you’re in the mood for no-frills Konkan food. 🦐

featured_reviews.name: darshana gavaskar
featured_reviews.review_text:
We tried the seafood thali here and it was absolutely delicious. The taste was very good and the ambiance of the restaurant is pleasant and welcoming. It’s a great place to visit with friends and family.

I ordered the fish thali, which included a variety of seafood items like crab, shellfish, prawns, and more. Everything was well-cooked and flavorful.

Overall, it was a great dining experience and I would definitely recommend this place to seafood lovers.

featured_reviews.name: NOSHIR KATRAK
featured_reviews.review_text:
Konkan Swad situated at Goregaon, M G Road.
Basically it is more apt for the sea food lovers.
No doubt, you can have chicken and mutton dishes also.
But sea food - O La! La!
They present you with the fresh catch, you can decide on the fish and as per it's weight the dish will be charged.
A decent Restaurant with a cordial atmosphere. Service was good but at times but slow.
Crab dishes are class.

featured_reviews.name: Dumc Finq
featured_reviews.review_text:
Location: Goregaon West

Food: Veg & Non-Veg

Specialties: Sea Food & Non-Veg cuisines

This is one of the popular restaurants in Goregaon West & has been here for long. If you love sea food, you need to visit this place once.

Recommendations:
- I recommend that before you order any fish, just make sure it's not stored for a long time... try getting this information from the waiter, else manager.

- Give them some cooking instructions, like the spice level you prefer, how you want the fish made, for example, rava fry or plain fry, etc.

- With fish, you should order thick rice, rice bhakri or neer dosa (for non-gravy or semi-gravy or sukkha fish dishes)... this is the best combination.

featured_reviews.name: John Paul Machado
featured_reviews.review_text:
have been a loyal customer of this restaurant many times, and the food has generally been good. However, my experience today was not just disappointing—it was an insult.
I paid an extremely expensive rate for a prawn dish that was utterly tasteless. The curry was clearly a generic, mass-produced base being served for every dish on the menu. This food was worse than what you get at a local roadside joint; I could have bought two excellent fish thalis at a Versova spot for the same price and enjoyed them infinitely more.
After confronting the owner about the "third-class" quality of the food, the response was appalling. Instead of offering a genuine apology or a meaningful resolution, I was given a token ₹100 discount. Worse, the owner looked at me as if I were making him lose money.
The food is now garbage, the prices are highway robbery, and the customer service is contemptuous. A truly wasted place.

featured_reviews.name: Ap Consultants
featured_reviews.review_text: Located around bhangur nagar on link road this seafood speciality restaurant is nice if you are looking for a no frills and basic air-conditioned place to enjoy fresh seafood. Service is fast I must say. It's got limited seating but with a wide variety of seafood as well as chicken and mutton preparations. Four wheeler parking can be an issue here though two wheeler can be managed around the restaurant on the street.
